item.description:

Snow outside the window She is sitting on the toilet Constipation as always Then send him a message

what are you doing?

Alive. . . Let’s make a location sharing Well, it seems to be a bit far away Okay? More than 10,000 kilometers

Dreaming and dreaming last night was so hard, she wrote blankly Dreaming of you, you came to see me and brought your wife, like Xiaoqian (read Xī), I don’t know why I work in a school. It turned out to meet so calmly, you are like my old friend, I smile and listen to you. She was white, thin, shoulder-length yellow hair, southerner, very polite, very likable girl. The bell rang, I said I was going to class, and said goodbye in a hurry. Later I found out that the ringtone was my alarm, and everything was a fantasy.
